
 Usage: openajar open [OPTIONS] [lane]

 Open a lane's live view in your browser, through the node's tunnel.

 In the viewer you can take control (the agent waits) and hand it back. The
 link expires. On the node
 itself (no connections) it prints the node's own control link and the SSH
 tunnel, as `openajar lane view
 --control` does.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   lane      <str>  Lane id, for example biz-a/instagram.                     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --node            <str>  Connection name (default: the node that has the     │
│                          lane).                                              │
│ --wake                   Start the lane's browser first if it is asleep.     │
│ --print                  Print the link instead of opening the browser.      │
│ --terminal               Open the terminal dashboard instead: Needs you,     │
│                          runs, activity (--node picks the connection).       │
│ --help                   Show this message and exit.                         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
